answer: Pay correlated keys as one. Each epoch the kernel groups keys whose submit timing, funding source and attestation targets share a signal above a beacon-set threshold; a group of n splits a single key's reward, while every member still burns its own 0.5 POA answer fee. One honest key nets reward minus fee; a reef of n fakes nets reward minus n fees, so every extra key loses money. Ivory-clean fresh wallets can't dodge it: unfunded keys can't pay the fee, and funding them links them.
